# Tele-GEMS <img class="flag" src="../../images/flags/gb.svg" alt="English" style="vertical-align:middle;margin-left:.4rem">

[Tele-Global Examination of Mental State · English materials]{.sub}
:::

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The English protocols and instructions are translations of the original Italian test, provided for cross-cultural validation. The normative data and cut-offs come from the Italian sample.
:::

## Main characteristics

::: {.facts}
::: {.fact}
[Normative sample]{.fact-label}

[healthy Italian adults, North, Centre and South of Italy]{.fact-note}
:::
::: {.fact}
[Clinical sample]{.fact-label}
[30]{.fact-value}
[patients with multiple sclerosis]{.fact-note}
:::
::: {.fact}
[Administration]{.fact-label}
[~10 min]{.fact-value}
[remote, by telephone]{.fact-note}
:::
::: {.fact}
[Inter-rater agreement]{.fact-label}
[ICC 0.98]{.fact-value}
[50 participants]{.fact-note}
:::
:::

### Psychometric properties

| Property | Result |
|---|---|
| Internal consistency | Cronbach's α = 0.74 |
| Test-retest reliability (2-month interval, n = 50) | r = 0.62 |
| Inter-rater reliability (n = 50) | ICC = 0.98 |
| Parallel forms (Tele-GEMS A vs B, n = 101) | r = 0.75 |
| Criterion validity | Predicted by the in-person GEMS (n = 100) |
| Construct validity | Related to MoCA (n = 50) and to a neuropsychological summary score in MS patients |
| Norms | Regression-based cut-offs for age, sex, education and Cognitive Reserve Index |
| Follow-up | Thresholds for significant change over time |
: {.props}

**Tasks:** orientation, immediate memory recall, backward months, spatial representation, naming, delayed memory recall, verbal comprehension, auditory attention, verbal fluency, metaphor comprehension.
